title: 第9章 闹！争！-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》
content:
第(1/3)页

    所有人的目光都转向了林美玲。

    陈建国的脸色变了，在桌子底下拉了她一把。

    林美玲甩开他的手，梗着脖子说：“我说的不对吗？

    二哥的木料、二哥的钱，都是真金白银的东西，凭什么不算？

    大哥的房子是用二哥的木料盖的，那大哥是不是该给二哥补钱？

    三哥娶媳妇的钱是借二哥的，那他是不是该还钱？”

    “林美玲！”李红霞的声音尖得像刀子，“你一个嫁出去的闺女，有什么资格在这儿指手画脚？！

    你家的事还不够你操心的？跑回娘家来搅和什么？！”

    “妈，我不是搅和，我是说公道话……”

    “公道话？”周桂芳冷笑一声，“美玲，你是嫁出去的人，泼出去的水，娘家的家产跟你没关系。

    你少在这儿充大尾巴狼。”

    “大嫂，你……”

    “美玲，”林国栋也开口了，语气阴阳怪气的，“你是不是看不得家里好？二哥都没说什么，你急什么？

    哦，我知道了……你是不是也想分一杯羹啊？

    嫁出去的闺女惦记娘家的家产，说出去也不怕人笑话。”

    “你！”林美玲气得脸通红，眼眶都红了，“三哥你胡说八道什么？！

    我什么时候说要分家产了？我只是说二哥的木料和钱应该算清楚……”

    “算清楚什么算清楚？”李红霞越说越激动，“那是一家人！一家人帮衬一下怎么了？

    你二哥当初愿意给的，又不是谁逼他的！现在翻旧账算什么意思？

    是不是要把你二哥小时候吃的奶也折成钱算一算？！”

    这话说得太难听了。

    赵素梅的脸白了，抱着林薇的手在发抖。

    林美玲的眼泪在眼眶里打转，嘴唇哆嗦着说不出话。

    陈建国的脸黑得像锅底，他猛地站起来，拽住林美玲的胳膊：“走！回家！我说不让你来你偏来，来了就惹事！”

    “建国，你放开我……”

    “走！”

    林国强站了起来。

    他站起来的速度不快，但有一种不容置疑的力量。

    他先看了陈建国一眼，那一眼很平静，但陈建国不知道为什么，拽着林美玲的手不自觉地松了。

    然后他转向李红霞。

    “妈，您刚才说的那句话，我记下了。”
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Everyone’s eyes turned to Lin Meiling.

Chen Jianguo's expression changed and he pulled her under the table.

Lin Meiling shook off his hand and said with a pinched neck, "Am I wrong?

Second brother’s wood and second brother’s money are both real money and silver, so why shouldn’t they be counted?

The eldest brother’s house was built with the second brother’s wood. Should the eldest brother give the second brother additional money?

The money the third brother borrowed to marry his wife was borrowed from the second brother, so should he pay it back?"

"Lin Meiling!" Li Hongxia's voice was as sharp as a knife, "As a married girl, what qualifications do you have to dictate here?!

Your family’s affairs are not enough for you to worry about?Why are you running back to your parents' house to cause trouble?!"

“Mom, I’m not trying to stir things up, I’m just speaking out...”

"To be fair?" Zhou Guifang sneered, "Meiling, you are the one who got married, so your natal family's property has nothing to do with you.

“Don’t act like a big-tailed wolf here."

"Sister-in-law, you..."

"Meiling," Lin Guodong also spoke, with a sinister tone, "Don't you think the family is good? The second brother didn't say anything. Why are you anxious?

Oh, I see... Do you also want a share of the pie?

A married daughter cares about her mother’s family property and is not afraid of being laughed at if she talks about it."

"You!" Lin Meiling was so angry that her face turned red and her eyes were red, "Third brother, what are you talking about?!

When did I say I wanted to divide the family property?I just said that the second brother’s wood and money should be clearly accounted for..."

"What does it mean to be clear?" Li Hongxia became more and more excited as she spoke, "That's a family! What's wrong with a family helping me?"

Your second brother was willing to give it in the first place, and no one forced him to do so!What does it mean to settle old scores now?

Do you want to convert the milk your second brother had when he was a child into money?!"

This is too ugly to say.

Zhao Sumei’s face turned pale, and her hands holding Lin Wei were trembling.

Lin Meiling’s tears welled up in her eyes, her lips were trembling and she couldn’t speak.

Chen Jianguo's face was as dark as the bottom of a pot. He stood up suddenly and grabbed Lin Meiling's arm: "Let's go! Go home! I told you not to come, but you go here and cause trouble when you come!"

"Jianguo, let me go..."

"Let's go!"

Lin Guoqiang stood up.

He didn’t stand up quickly, but he had an undeniable strength.

He glanced at Chen Jianguo first, and that look was very calm, but Chen Jianguo didn't know why, but he unconsciously let go of Lin Meiling's hand.

Then he turned to Li Hongxia.

“Mom, I’ve written down what you just said.”
